description: Safer, Faster, Smarter: Pairing Cloud-Based Vehicle Preemption and AI Intersection Video Analytics [supporting dataset] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Christina Karanikolas, Regional Transportation Commission of Southern Nevada. RTC’s Safer, Smarter, Faster smart technology traffic signal project utilized a cloud-based signal timing optimization system that supports transit signal priority (TSP) and enhances safety using artificial intelligence intersection analytics (AIA). The limits for Stage 1 pilot project encompass UMC hospital and downtown Las Vegas. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
